name: AI Email Triage with Auto-Drafted Gmail Replies

parameters.content:
## AI Email Triage with Auto-Drafted Gmail Replies
Every incoming email is classified, then routed: answerable ones get a Gmail draft written from your knowledge base, anything uncertain or sensitive goes to a human, and noise gets labelled and left alone.

## How it works
1. A new email arrives
2. AI classifies it into one of your categories and judges whether your knowledge base actually covers it
3. The result is logged, then routed three ways:
   - **Draft** - confident and answerable: a reply is drafted into Gmail
   - **Escalate** - low confidence, sensitive category, or not covered: a human is emailed instead
   - **Ignore** - spam and newsletters: labelled, no reply
4. Nothing is ever sent to a customer. Drafts wait for you.

## Setup
- [ ] Connect Gmail OAuth2 credentials to all four Gmail nodes
- [ ] Connect OpenAI credentials in OpenAI Chat Model
- [ ] Connect Google Sheets credentials in Log Triage, using a sheet with these headers:
      Date, From, Subject, Category, Confidence, Outcome, Summary, Reason
- [ ] Open Triage Config and set your categories, which always go to a human, which are ignored, your escalation email, your ignore label ID, and your real knowledge base text

## Customize
Everything that decides behaviour lives in Triage Config - categories, thresholds, routing. Change it there, never in the nodes. Lower ConfidenceThreshold to draft more aggressively, raise it to send more to humans.
**Drafts only - nothing is ever sent to a customer.** The only email this workflow sends is the internal escalation notice to your own address.

## 1. Classify
One config node drives everything. AI returns a category, a confidence score, and whether your knowledge base can actually answer the question.

## 2. Log & Route
Every email is logged whatever happens to it, then routed by outcome.

## 3. Handle By Outcome
Three different endings: draft a reply, hand it to a human, or label it and stop.
